title: MyLinden prescription terms: repeat losses and the replaced share
content:
**Replaced share of a replacement fill — Prescriptions & Renewals terms.**

(1) Where an earlier replacement fill was posted on this prescription in the last 24 calendar months and the patient has no missed visit with the prescribing department in the last 12 calendar months, the share is 75 percent; where there was such an earlier replacement and the patient has one or more missed visits with that department in those 12 months, the share is 50 percent; otherwise the share is 100 percent.

(2) An earlier replacement fill is a replacement authorization posted on this same prescription's fill ledger, dated within the 24 calendar months before the day of the replacement.

(3) A missed visit is a visit among the patient's In-Person Appointments with the department of the prescriber on this prescription that is recorded as a no-show, scheduled within the 12 calendar months before the day of the replacement. A missed visit with another department does not count.

**Combinations.**

| Earlier replacement on this prescription in 24 months | Missed visits with the prescribing department in 12 months | Replaced share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | 75 percent |
| yes | one or more | 50 percent |
| no | none | 100 percent |
| no | one or more | 100 percent |

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- A first-ever replacement on the prescription, although the patient missed two visits last spring: 100 percent.
- A replacement 20 months ago on the same prescription and a perfect attendance record with the department: 75 percent.
- A replacement 20 months ago and one no-show with the prescribing department 3 months ago: 50 percent.
- A replacement 26 months ago: outside the 24 months, so 100 percent.
